entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Labeler Bot labels zero-diff PRs as area-Infrastructure #133807
  • Switch Windows x86 GC to software write-watch and remove OS-backed write-watch #133799
  • github60486 failed with NRE at Program.ValidateRecursiveCurrentMethod(Int32 depth) #133798
  • Process-wide barrier implemented as thread_get_state sometimes hangs in Rosetta #133797
  • Building library tests for NativeAot with checked runtime fails due to analyzer assert #133796
  • Experiment with WebAssembly branch hints for CoreCLR ReadyToRun #133794
    Future
  • `CompositeFormat.Parse` overflows `int` on a large format-item index, giving `IndexOutOfRangeException` or a silently wrong argument #133792
  • Clean build of release/10.0 fails restore with NU1903 (Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native) #133791
  • JIT: (bug) object stack allocation has no per-method frame budget - mutually exclusive allocations sum into the frame (stack overflow) #133788
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) Assertion failed '!node->IsUserCall()' during 'Rationalize IR' with an identity Vector128.Shuffle #133787
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) assert `unreached` in `UpdateAncestorTypes` for `GT_STORE_LCL_FLD` with `(S?)(object)s` and a stack-allocated field #133786
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) x64: assert `dstOffset < (INT32_MAX - size)` in `genCodeForInitBlkUnroll`/`genCodeForCpBlkUnroll` for a boundary address-mode displacement #133785
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) x64: unrolled memmove and initblk use YMM/ZMM but never emit `vzeroupper` #133784
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) x64: `BitOperations.Log2`/`TrailingZeroCount` compared against 0 produces wrong results when the BSR/BSF fallback is used #133783
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) LEA address-mode folding silently deletes a nested `checked` multiply (missing `OverflowException`) #133782
    12.0.0
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: System.Net.Http.Functional.Tests.PlatformHandler_HttpClientHandler_Http2_Test.SendAsync_RequestWithLatin [Content truncated due to length] #133779
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: System.Net.Sockets.Tests.AcceptDualStackResetTests.Accept_DualStackListener_PeerImmediatelyResets_Listen [Content truncated due to length] #133778
  • [ci-scan] Interpreter assert SetInterpreterCode: m_interpreterCode != INTERPRETER_CODE_POISON (method.hpp:1992) crashes test hos [Content truncated due to length] #133771
  • [ci-scan] Build break: cDAC/DAC Windows leg fails — -cdacPath requires the matching universal DBI mscordbi_universal.dll #133770

Closed

  • Delete FEATURE_COUNT_GC_WRITE_BARRIERS #133780
  • JIT: (bug) value numbering asserts when constant-folding 64-bit `PopCount`/`LeadingZeroCount`/`TrailingZeroCount` #133560
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) Loop stepped by checked(i - (-1)) is unrolled to one iteration, dropping an OverflowException #133583
    12.0.0
  • [Mono][Windows] MiniJIT crashes across unrelated runtime tests with FAST_FAIL_SET_CONTEXT_DENIED #133702
  • JIT: (bug) a `Vector512` conditional select over a comparison of `CreateScalarUnsafe` values asserts during lowering #133554
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `Vector128.Dot` with a scalar-widened operand hits a JIT assert #133551
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) box/unbox.any fold on Nullable<T> keeps the payload of a HasValue == false value #133721
    12.0.0
